results.title: One arrested with 30gm chitta in Shimla
results.description: One person has been arrested with 30 grams of chitta (heroin) near Shimla, the police said on Monday. The accused has been identified as Gopal Singh Katwal, 33, a native of Mandi district who is currently residing in Shimla’s Tutikandi area. According to police, the action followed a tip-off about a person allegedly carrying chitta [...]
